Container.Name: rockett-cad
Container.Overview:
Rockett CAD — self-hosted, browser-based parametric CAD for designing 3D-printable parts. Feature-history solid modelling on a real B-Rep kernel (OpenCascade), with STL and 3MF export.
Build the image locally first (docker build -t rockett-cad:latest .) or point Repository at your own registry.
Container.Description: Self-hosted parametric CAD (Fusion-style sketch → constrain → extrude → timeline workflow) for 3D printing. All projects, reference images and exports live in the /data volume and survive container recreation.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage: project documents, uploaded reference images, exports
